messages.subject: Ken has moved on...
parts:
Hi,

just in case you don't already know: After almost five years at WEHI,
Ken Simpson decided to try another career, starting next week. This
time as a patent attorney. Unfortunately for us, this means he will
not have much time, if any at all, to answer questions about his exon
code in aroma.affymetrix. I'll try my best to pitch in where I can.

Ken, best wishes at your new place - I'm sure you'll excel there too.
Thanks for all great input and contributions to the package. I'll
miss the good chats.

Cheers

Henrik
